models.name: XController (model not named in the programming sheet)

entry.confirm_signal: Long tone about 2 s after power-up, then the melody 5-6-5 about 5 s later
steps: Wait about 5000 ms more: melody 5-6-5, programming mode entered

announce.description: 8 item tones loop. Item N is a tone of N short beeps, written beep, beep-beep, beep-b-beep, beep-b-b-beep and so on (a longer first and last beep around N-2 short ones is implied by the notation, not stated). Values are 1, 2 or 3 short beeps.

select.description: Item: throttle to min within 3000 ms after the tone.

value_select.description: Value: throttle to max after hearing the value tone.

scheme.confirm_signal: Melody 5-6-5 after a value is stored.
scheme.exit: After 5-6-5, throttle to min within 2000 ms; or item 8 then throttle to min within 3000 ms.
scheme.description: Throttle max, battery on, long tone at about 2 s, melody 5-6-5 at about 5 s later. Eight item tones loop; throttle to min within 3 s selects one. Value tones loop; throttle to max on the wanted tone stores it (5-6-5) and returns to the item loop.

unknowns: Beep duration in ms is not stated.
Gap between beeps and between tones is not stated.
Window to select a value after its tone is not stated.
Whether 'beep-b-beep' means a long first and last beep is not stated.
Models covered by the sheet are not named; the mlhobby copy is titled 'XC Lite Manual' and says XController.
Defaults of brake and cutoff threshold are in conflict, see notes.
notes: Dualsky_XController_FR.pdf (Flash RC, French) and Dualsky_XController_Lite_programming.pdf (English) carry the same menu.
Conflict: English sheet says brake default is Disabled; French sheet says brake active by default. No default flag set on item 1.
Conflict: English sheet default cutoff threshold is High; French sheet says medium. Nixx cutoff: English 0 %/50 %/60 % of start voltage; French 60 %/65 %/70 %. No default flag set on item 4.
French sheet names value 3 of item 3 'stop' and value 3 of item 5 'tres doux'.
Dualsky_XController_Lite.pdf (XC-xx-Lite, Roxxy-style) uses a different gesture set and is a separate profile.
